vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: vedic-destiny
Version: 1.0.3

The skill bundle provides a comprehensive Vedic astrology analysis system. It utilizes local Python scripts (scripts/chart_sanity_check.py and scripts/build_report_html.py) to validate astrological data and generate HTML reports from markdown sections. The instructions in SKILL.md and the reference files (e.g., 总盘.md, 术语框架.md) enforce strict calculation rules and a two-stage verification process to ensure birth time accuracy before full analysis. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection was found; the code and instructions are consistent with the stated purpose.

llm.summary: This appears to be a coherent local astrology-report skill, but it can run included Python scripts and leave personal chart reports on disk.

dimensions.detail: The references and helper scripts align with the stated Chinese Vedic chart analysis/reporting purpose; no unrelated credential, network, or account-access behavior is evidenced.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill conditionally instructs use of local Python helper scripts for chart validation and HTML report building, which is purpose-aligned but still means local code execution on user-supplied files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Registry metadata says there is no install spec and no required binaries, while the skill includes scripts and documents Python commands; this is an under-declared runtime requirement rather than suspicious behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill reads user-provided chart data and writes local report folders/HTML files. This is proportionate to the reporting purpose, but the output may contain personal birth, relationship, career, or timing information.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistent local report artifacts are explicitly part of the workflow. No credentials, privilege escalation, background workers, or autonomous persistence are evidenced.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable with a local Python-based workflow and with the skill creating chart-report files on disk. Keep source chart files and generated reports private, especially if they include birth details, relationship questions, career history, or other sensitive personal information.

evidence.explanation: The skill directs the agent to run included local Python helper scripts for chart validation and report packaging. This is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should notice that local code may execute on supplied files.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use it on files and folders you control, and review the included scripts if you are uncomfortable with local Python execution.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The skill may process local chart/report files and create output files through included scripts, but no external network or credential handling is evidenced.

evidence.explanation: The registry does not provide source/homepage provenance or an install spec, yet the artifact includes runnable helper scripts. The scripts are present in the package and no suspicious static findings were reported, so this is a provenance/runtime clarity note rather than a concern.
evidence.snippet: Source: unknown; Homepage: none ... No install spec — this is an instruction-only skill ... Code file presence: 3 code file(s)

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Publisher should declare the Python runtime/helper-script expectation and provide clearer source provenance; users should inspect included scripts before relying on them.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A user may not know from metadata alone that Python helper scripts are part of the intended workflow.

evidence.explanation: The workflow creates persistent local report files and metadata containing personal chart/profile fields. This is expected for a report generator, but it leaves sensitive personal analysis artifacts on disk.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use an anonymous client name when possible, store reports in a private folder, and delete or protect generated files if the contents are sensitive.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Birth-chart details, relationship/career analysis, names, or other personal information may remain in local report files after the session.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses disclosed local Python helper scripts and has minor metadata/provenance under-disclosure; no hidden network, destructive, or autonomous behavior is evidenced.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, privileged account access, tokens, cookies, or delegated authority are requested or evidenced.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill can create persistent local reports containing personal chart and profile information, but no exfiltration or external sharing is evidenced.
